SPIREBROTHERS-LOGIC.title: Logic
SPIREBROTHERS-HANDS.title: Handy
SPIREBROTHERS-STRATAGEM.title: Stratagem
SPIREBROTHERS-STRATAGEM.description: Can only be played after you enter its input this turn by playing [gold]Logic[/gold] and [gold]Handy[/gold] cards in that order.
SPIREBROTHERS-WIRED.title: Wired
SPIREBROTHERS-WIRED.description: Active if you've already played a card of the other type ([gold]Logic[/gold] or [gold]Handy[/gold]) this turn.
SPIREBROTHERS-SHARE.title: Share
SPIREBROTHERS-SHARE.description: Choose a player. In solo play, it targets you.
SPIREBROTHERS-DILIGENT.title: Diligent
SPIREBROTHERS-DILIGENT.description: This card gets stronger each time you play it this combat.
SPIREBROTHERS-COMEBACK.title: Comeback
SPIREBROTHERS-COMEBACK.description: Deals bonus damage to [gold]Insulted[/gold] enemies, then removes [gold]Insulted[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-EXACT.title: Exact
SPIREBROTHERS-EXACT.description: A bonus if you have exactly 0 energy left after paying for this card. X-cost cards always count.
SPIREBROTHERS-HOARD.title: Hoard
SPIREBROTHERS-HOARD.description: Gets stronger the more [gold]Gold[/gold] you're holding.
SPIREBROTHERS-RANT.title: Rant
SPIREBROTHERS-RANT.description: Gets stronger for each Rant card you already played this turn. Whoever has to listen pays the price.
SPIREBROTHERS-DELEGATE.title: Delegate
SPIREBROTHERS-DELEGATE.description: A player's next Attack deals double damage.
SPIREBROTHERS-SONG.title: Song
SPIREBROTHERS-CHORUS.title: Chorus
SPIREBROTHERS-CHORUS.description: Spends ALL your [gold]Verses[/gold] for an effect that grows with each one spent. [gold]Held[/gold] Verses (kept from last turn) count double. A Chorus counts at most 10.
SPIREBROTHERS-CHECK.title: Check
SPIREBROTHERS-CHECK.description: Find a random item for a random player: [gold]Filler[/gold] (6 [gold]Block[/gold]), [gold]Useful[/gold] (draw 1 next turn), [gold]Progression[/gold] (1 energy next turn), or a [gold]Trap[/gold] (an enemy gets 1 [gold]Weak[/gold] and 1 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold]).
SPIREBROTHERS-ROLL.title: Roll
SPIREBROTHERS-ROLL.description: Roll a d20. On a 1 ([gold]Fumble[/gold]) the effect is halved; on a 20 ([gold]Natural 20[/gold]) it's doubled.
SPIREBROTHERS-SCRIPT.title: Script
SPIREBROTHERS-SCRIPT.description: At the start of your next turn, this card's effect happens again for free. Write it once, let it run.
SPIREBROTHERS-KIDS.title: Kids
SPIREBROTHERS-KIDS.description: Tim has up to 8. At the end of your turn, each Kid deals 1 damage to a random enemy.
SPIREBROTHERS-AGE.title: Age
SPIREBROTHERS-AGE.description: Tim's Age lasts the whole run. Each Age gives all his cards +1 damage and +1 [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Age Up[/gold] advances it: Dark, Feudal, Castle, then Imperial.
SPIREBROTHERS-DUO.title: Duo
SPIREBROTHERS-DUO.description: Made for teaming up with the teammate it names. Only shows up in card rewards and shops when they are in your party.
SPIREBROTHERS-CHEM.title: Chem
SPIREBROTHERS-CHEM.description: John's Hive Scum chems. Chem cards react with [gold]Toxin[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-GRIND.title: Grind
SPIREBROTHERS-GRIND.description: The first time you play this card each combat, its number goes up for the rest of the run.
SPIREBROTHERS-TOXIN.title: Toxin
SPIREBROTHERS-TOXIN.description: A debuff that does nothing on its own and never wears off. [gold]Chem[/gold] cards react with it.
SPIREBROTHERS-SHROUD.title: Shroud
SPIREBROTHERS-SHROUD.description: Enshrouded's fog. While you're in it, your Attacks deal 50% more damage, but you lose 1 HP at the end of each of your turns. It lasts a set number of turns.
SPIREBROTHERS-LAW.title: Law
SPIREBROTHERS-LAW.description: A Power that sets a rule for the fight. Any enemy that breaks it is punished right away.
SPIREBROTHERS-MASTIFF.title: Mastiff
SPIREBROTHERS-MASTIFF.description: Huffman's cyber-mastiff. At the end of his turn it bites the [gold]Marked[/gold] enemy (a random one if none is Marked) for its [gold]Bite[/gold] damage.
SPIREBROTHERS-BUILD.title: Build
SPIREBROTHERS-BUILD.description: Build X: if you have X [gold]Metal[/gold], spend it for the bonus. Without it, the card still works.
SPIREBROTHERS-METAL.title: Metal
SPIREBROTHERS-METAL.description: Huffman's Metal builds up during combat. [gold]Build[/gold] cards spend it.
